entities.name: Lascaux Cave Paintings
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Stunning Paleolithic cave paintings (c. 17,000 BCE) in southwestern France depicting animals, humans, and abstract signs. Among the finest examples of prehistoric art and evidence of complex symbolic thought.
